questions.question: My home is located next to a forest or an area with abundant vegetation
My home is situated on a slope or at the top of a ridge
The exterior cladding of my home is made of combustible material (such as wood or plastic)
The roof, porch, or balcony are made of combustible material
The glass in exterior windows and doors is single-pane
I have exterior windows and doors without protection, without shutters or blinds
I have ventilation openings and/or chimneys without any protection
There is an accumulation of plant debris and/or combustible materials (such as plastic furniture or junk) around the home
There is an accumulation of leaves and twigs in the gutters and/or on the roof
There is a fuel tank and/or butane cylinders near the building
